<style>
:root{--t-bg:#ffffff;--t-fg:#0B0B12;--t-muted:#5A5B6A;--t-card:#F7F7FB;--t-border:#EAEAF2;--t-accent:#6366F1;--t-accent2:#A855F7;--t-grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#6366F1 0%,#A855F7 100%);--t-glow:radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(99,102,241,.18) 0%, rgba(168,85,247,.10) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 72%);--t-nav:rgba(255,255,255,.72);--t-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(30,20,80,.28)}
html[data-theme="dark"]{--t-bg:#07070C;--t-fg:#F4F4FA;--t-muted:#9B9CAF;--t-card:#101019;--t-border:#20212E;--t-accent:#818CF8;--t-accent2:#C084FC;--t-grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#818CF8 0%,#C084FC 100%);--t-glow:radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(129,140,248,.22) 0%, rgba(192,132,252,.12) 40%, rgba(7,7,12,0) 72%);--t-nav:rgba(12,12,18,.72);--t-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
*{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}body{background:var(--t-bg);margin:0}
a{text-decoration:none}
summary{list-style:none}summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-plus{transition:transform .2s ease}details[open] .faq-plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}
@media(max-width:768px){.bx-nav-links{display:none!important}}
</style>
<script>(function(){var MOON='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3a6 6 0 0 0 9 9 9 9 0 1 1-9-9Z"/></svg>';var SUN='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2"/><path d="M12 20v2"/><path d="m4.93 4.93 1.41 1.41"/><path d="m17.66 17.66 1.41 1.41"/><path d="M2 12h2"/><path d="M20 12h2"/><path d="m6.34 17.66-1.41 1.41"/><path d="m19.07 4.93-1.41 1.41"/></svg>';function syncIcon(t){var b=document.querySelector('[data-theme-toggle]');if(b)b.innerHTML=(t==='dark'?SUN:MOON);}function cur(){return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');}function set(t){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);try{localStorage.setItem('site-theme',t)}catch(e){}syncIcon(t);}var s=null;try{s=localStorage.getItem('site-theme')}catch(e){}set(s||'light');document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){syncIcon(cur());});document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var el=e.target.closest('[data-theme-toggle]');if(el){e.preventDefault();set(cur()==='dark'?'light':'dark')}});})();</script>
